Provider.auditedBadgeHint: Gafere nyocha ogo Zervia — akara dị irè ọnwa 6
Provider.agreementQuality: Nyefee ihe ị kpọsara, zaghachi ngwa ngwa, mechaa ntinye akwụkwọ gị.
Provider.agreementFees: Ụgwọ ikpo okwu: 10% n'efu / 5% ndị otu — a na-egosi mgbe niile tupu ị nabata ntinye.
Provider.agreementAudit1: Zervia na-eme nyocha ogo na-enweghị usoro na ndị na-enye ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ. A na-ahọrọ ndị ọhụrụ na ndị nwere akara dị ala karịa.
Provider.agreementAudit2: Nyocha ọ bụla na-enye akara nlele isii n'ime 100: izu oke profaịlụ (15), ọsọ nzaghachi (15), akara nyocha (25), ọnụego mmecha (20), ọnọdụ nkwenye ID (15), na mkpesa (10).
Provider.agreementAudit3: 80+ gafere, 50–79 nata ịdọ aka ná ntị, ihe na-erughị 50 nwere ike kwụsịtụ. Onye otu Zervia na-enyocha akara mgbe niile tupu ịdọ aka ná ntị ma ọ bụ nkwụsịtụ ọ bụla — usoro anaghị akwụsịtụ onye ọ bụla n'onwe ya.
Provider.agreementAudit4: Ịdọ aka ná ntị na-edepụta ihe ị ga-edozi ma nye gị ụbọchị 7. Dozie n'oge na akaụntụ gị ga-adị mma.
Provider.agreementAudit5: Ịgafe na-enye akara 🏅 Enyochala gbakwunyere ụgwọ ikpo okwu dị ala ruo ọnwa 6: 8% kama 10% (n'efu), 4% kama 5% (ndị otu). Akara na mbelata na-agwụ mgbe ọnwa 6 gasịrị; nyocha ọhụrụ na-emegharị ha.
Provider.agreementAudit6: Nyocha bụ naanị nlele ogo — anaghị ana gị ụgwọ, anaghị ejide ego gị, ma anaghị etinye bank gị ma ọ bụ akaụntụ Stripe gị.

Provider.errorAgreementRequired: Biko nabata Nkwekọrịta Onye Ọrụ ka ị gaa n'ihu.

Policies.legalNoteBody: Nke a bụ nchịkọta n'asụsụ dị mfe. Zervia ga-eme ka onye ọka iwu nyochaa ederede iwu zuru oke tupu mmalite.
Policies.terms_intro_body: Zervia connects customers with local service providers. By using Zervia you agree to these terms. Zervia is a marketplace: providers are independent — we introduce, you decide.
Policies.terms_accounts_body: You must provide accurate information and keep your password private. One account per person. You must be of legal age in your country to book services.
Policies.terms_providers_body: Listings must describe real services you can deliver. Fake, misleading, or illegal listings are removed and repeat offenders are banned. New providers are approved by our team before going public.
Policies.terms_payments_body: Subscriptions and boosts are billed through Stripe. Prices are shown before you pay; taxes may apply in your country. You can cancel subscriptions anytime from your billing page.
Policies.terms_conduct_body: No spam, scams, harassment, or fake reviews. Reviews may only come from real completed bookings. Breaking these rules can end your account.
Policies.terms_termination_body: You can delete your account anytime from the privacy center. We may suspend accounts that break these terms, with an explanation and a chance to appeal.
Policies.terms_changes_body: We'll post updates here and notify you of important changes before they take effect.
Policies.privacy_intro_body: Zervia collects only what it needs to run the marketplace. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights (including under Canada's PIPEDA and the EU/UK GDPR).
Policies.privacy_collect_body: Account details (name, email, country, language), listings and bookings you create, reviews, support messages, and ID photos you choose to upload for verification. We never see your payment card details — Stripe handles those.
Policies.privacy_use_body: To operate your account, show listings, process bookings, prevent fraud, and improve Zervia. We do not sell your personal data. Ever.
Policies.privacy_share_body: Your public profile, listings, and reviews are visible to everyone. ID verification photos are private — only you and the Zervia review team can see them. We share data with service providers we need to run Zervia (hosting, payments, email) under strict contracts.
Policies.privacy_rights_body: Access, correct, export, or delete your data — anytime, from the in-app privacy center. We'll respond to requests promptly as the law requires.
Policies.privacy_security_body: Passwords are handled by our auth provider (we never see them), data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is strictly limited by role.
Policies.privacy_contact_body: Contact us through the support hub in the app — we answer privacy questions first.
Policies.refunds_intro_body: If Zervia charges you for something that didn't work as described, we'll make it right. Here's exactly how.
Policies.refunds_subscriptions_body: Cancel anytime from your billing page — you keep the paid period, and it won't renew. Refunds for the current period are granted if you cancel within 7 days of being charged and haven't used paid features since.
Policies.refunds_boosts_body: Boosts start immediately when activated and can't be refunded once live. If a boost never activated due to our error, you get a full refund or a free re-run — your choice.
Policies.refunds_leadfees_body: Lead fees are only charged on genuine customer bookings. Duplicate or fraudulent leads are credited — report them and we investigate within 3 business days.
Policies.refunds_disputes_body: Payments for services go to providers, not Zervia — we can't refund their work, but our dispute team mediates and documents every case. Open a dispute from your booking page.
Policies.refunds_contact_body: Open a support ticket from the app (category: billing) and we'll respond within 2 business days.
Policies.offlineBody: Zervia chọrọ ịntanetị maka ibe a.

WhyZervia.translationNote: This page is currently available in English. Translations are in progress.
WhyZervia.heroTitle: Tired of surprise fees and weeks of waiting? There's a better way.
WhyZervia.heroSub: Some platforms can mark up jobs by 20% or more — or make you wait weeks just for a quote. Zervia keeps fees low, shows you the real price upfront, and lets you book in minutes. For every kind of service, in your language.
WhyZervia.pain1Text: You agree to a $100 job, then checkout says $122.50. Some platforms add a 15% service fee plus another ~7.5% “trust fee” on top of every booking.
WhyZervia.pain2Text: Request a quote. Wait 48 hours for a callback. Wait 2–4 weeks for the work. For big-box home services, that's normal — and there's no price until the consultation is over.
WhyZervia.pain3Text: Hourly billing means watching the meter run. Is this a 2-hour job or a 5-hour job? You won't know until the invoice arrives.
WhyZervia.painTransition: We built Zervia to fix all three.
WhyZervia.compareFootnote: Competitor figures reflect Zervia's good-faith reading of publicly available information, last updated October 2026. Offerings, fees, and features may change without notice — please verify current terms directly with each provider. TaskRabbit and Home Depot are trademarks of their respective owners; their mention here implies no endorsement. Zervia makes no warranty about the accuracy or completeness of third-party information.
WhyZervia.row1Zervia: 10% (free plan) / 5% (members) — deducted from provider earnings. Customers pay no platform fee.
WhyZervia.row1TaskRabbit: ~22.5% total in added customer fees (15% service + ~7.5% trust & support)
WhyZervia.row2Zervia: Fixed quote agreed upfront, held in escrow
WhyZervia.row2TaskRabbit: Hourly rate — final total depends on hours worked
WhyZervia.row2HomeDepot: Quote only after a free in-home consultation
WhyZervia.row8Zervia: Escrow — money released when the job is done
WhyZervia.custTitle: Know your price before the work starts.
WhyZervia.custIntro: No meters running. No mystery quotes. No large upfront deposits. Here's what booking on Zervia actually feels like:
WhyZervia.custB1Text: You and your provider agree on the price before anyone lifts a finger.
WhyZervia.custB2Text: Your money is held safely and released only when the job is done right. You never pay for work that didn't happen.
WhyZervia.custB3Text: Providers pay 10% on the free plan and 5% as members — customers never pay a platform fee. Always shown upfront, never buried at checkout.
WhyZervia.custB4Text: Compare verified providers with real reviews — not whoever a store assigns you.
WhyZervia.custB5Text: Home services, beauty, tutoring, errands, rentals, flower delivery, and more — not just home repair.
WhyZervia.custB6Text: The whole platform in 10 languages, because great service shouldn't require perfect English.
WhyZervia.provTitle: Keep more of what you earn.
WhyZervia.provIntro: If you've worked on other gig platforms, you know the pattern: fees creep up, rates get squeezed, and a bad week can mean a paused account. Zervia was designed with providers at the table — not as an afterthought.
WhyZervia.provB1Text: 10% on the free plan, 5% as a member. No lead fees. No bidding for your own customers.
WhyZervia.provB2Text: Listing your business costs nothing. No $25 registration fee, no pay-to-be-seen advertising.
WhyZervia.provB3Text: Your storefront, your prices, your schedule — not an anonymous gig profile.
WhyZervia.provB4Text: Customer payments are held in escrow and released to you when the job is complete. No chasing invoices.
WhyZervia.provB5Text: Join early for free Pro features, priority placement, and direct access to our team while we grow together.
WhyZervia.provB6Text: Clear published policies and a genuine review process — no opaque algorithms deciding your livelihood.
WhyZervia.statCallout: Some platforms add up to ~22.5% in fees on top of every job. Zervia's fee is 10% — or 5% for members, deducted from provider earnings.
WhyZervia.prom1Text: The price you agree to is the price you pay. Fees are shown upfront, never buried at checkout.
WhyZervia.prom2Text: Escrow on every booking. Providers get paid when the work is done — customers never pay for work that wasn't.
WhyZervia.prom3Text: Verified reviews from real bookings. Reviews stay up once they meet our guidelines — they're never quietly removed.
WhyZervia.prom4Text: Direct access to real humans on our team. We publish our standards and we stand behind them.
WhyZervia.finalTitle: Ready for service without the surprises?
WhyZervia.finalSub: Join our growing community — fair prices, verified providers, and support that actually responds.
WhyZervia.finalNote: Free to join. No credit card required.

Guarantee.translationNote: This page is shown in English while translations are in progress. We're working on all 10 languages!
Guarantee.heroTitle: Don't love your first session? It's on us.
Guarantee.heroSubtitle: Trying a new tutor, stylist, or massage therapist shouldn't feel like a gamble. If your first session with a new provider isn't right, we'll refund you in full — and the provider still gets paid.
Guarantee.howSubtitle: Three simple steps. No forms, no fine print, no phone calls.
Guarantee.step1Text: Book any first session with a provider you've never used before in a covered category — tutoring, beauty, massage, fitness, caregiving, or cooking.
Guarantee.step2Text: If the session isn't what you hoped for, tap "Request guarantee refund" from your booking within 48 hours and tell us what happened in a sentence or two.
Guarantee.step3Text: We refund you in full within 5 business days. The provider still gets paid for their time — the cost comes from Zervia, not from them.
Guarantee.eligibleSubtitle: The guarantee applies to categories where personal fit matters most. Look for the 🛡️ badge when you browse.
Guarantee.covered1Title: Your first session with a new provider
Guarantee.covered1Text: The first completed booking you ever make with a given provider, in a covered category. The session must be marked complete.
Guarantee.covered2Text: You get back everything you paid for the session itself. Platform fees are included in the refund.
Guarantee.notCovered1Text: Once you've had a session with a provider, you know what to expect — the guarantee is for first sessions only.
Guarantee.notCovered2Text: If you didn't show up or cancelled after the provider's cancellation window, standard cancellation terms apply instead.
Guarantee.notCovered3Text: Physical goods, supplies, or materials purchased as part of the session are refunded under our standard refunds policy, not this guarantee.
Guarantee.rulesSubtitle: This guarantee is real — and it only works if it's fair to everyone. Here's the deal:
Guarantee.rule1: One guarantee claim per customer per category. Try tutoring risk-free, then try massage risk-free — but you can't claim twice for tutoring.
Guarantee.rule2: Claims must be filed within 48 hours of the session being marked complete. After that, our standard dispute process applies.
Guarantee.rule3: The session must be completed and paid through Zervia. Off-platform arrangements aren't covered.
Guarantee.rule4: We review every claim. Patterns of abuse — like booking only to claim refunds — will result in losing guarantee eligibility.
Guarantee.providerNoteText: When a customer claims the guarantee, Zervia pays the refund — not you. You still get paid in full for the session. We'd rather absorb the occasional cost than have customers afraid to try someone new. New providers get more first bookings, and great providers turn them into regulars.
Guarantee.finalSubtitle: The worst that happens is a free lesson in what you actually want.
